definitions.explanation: A place of Buddhist worship, distinct from Shinto shrines.

examples.japanese: お{寺|てら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{寺|てら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{参|まい}りします→参る：01322_mairu⟧。
examples.english: I visit the temple during Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧お{寺|てら}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ので、⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Kyoto has many old temples, so it's popular with tourists.

notes:
{寺|てら} (also お{寺|てら}) is a Buddhist temple, distinct from {神社|じんじゃ} (Shinto shrine).

TEMPLE vs SHRINE:
- {寺|てら}/{寺院|じいん}: Buddhist temple
- {神社|じんじゃ}: Shinto shrine

FAMOUS TEMPLES:
- {金閣寺|きんかくじ}: Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion)
- {清水寺|きよみずでら}: Kiyomizu-dera
- {東大寺|とうだいじ}: Todai-ji
- {浅草寺|せんそうじ}: Senso-ji

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{寺|てら}に{参|まい}る: to visit a temple
- {寺|てら}{院|いん}: temple (formal)
- 〜{寺|じ}/〜{寺|てら}: temple name suffix
